idea.title: Idea
idea.text: We dig into your business and your buyers, and find the hook that will catch your clients specifically.

system.title: System
system.text: We build the structure and scenarios: what people see first, where they click and where they leave a request.

design.title: Design
design.text: We create the brand's world: frames, type, motion. You see the site before any code is written.

development.title: Development
development.text: We build a fast site: scroll-driven video, 3D, animation and easy content editing.

launch.title: Launch
launch.text: Domain, analytics, search engines. The site runs, requests come in, and we stay in touch.
